symptom: `combobox cbCode (source: 'database', optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource: microflow Mod.GET_Parents, optionsSourceDatabaseItemSelection: 'Single', optionsSourceDatabaseCaptionAttribute: Name, optionsSourceDatabaseValueAttribute: Name, databaseAttributeString: Code)` — check "3 issues: 0 errors, 3 warnings" (MDL-WIDGET06 'recognized but not yet persisted' for the datasource and the item selection), exec "Created page", mx check "[CE0463] The definition of this widget has changed" at Combo box 'cbCode' (CE1613 on Mod.Child.Name when the data view's entity has no Name) (mendixlabs/mxcli#1583)
cause: Two layers. (1) combobox.def.json had no database mode: the datasource had no write path, the explicit-key pass wrote the Selection-typed item selection as a PrimitiveValue, and the caption/value attributes, linked to the unwritten datasource, bound to the data view's entity. (2) Once those were written CE0463 stayed: the editorConfig lifter skipped every hide after `"context"===t.source ? (…) :` — the database and static branches of an else-if chain, whose guard's boundary is the outer `:` — and unmappedHiddenResets counted a property mapped in ANY mode as written, while the mapping loop only visits the selected mode; so the hidden `optionsSourceType` kept the template's 'enumeration' and `selectAllButtonCaption` its populated template
file: `sdk/widgets/definitions/combobox.def.json` (database mode on `hasDataSource:optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource`), `mdl/executor/widget_engine.go` (explicit pass routes Selection via SetSelection; Selection mapping reads its key; unmappedHiddenResets takes the selected mappings), `mdl/executor/editorconfig_extract.go` (elseChainTerms, groupElseChain, parseGuard `:` boundary, else-branch hides inherit enclosing group terms), `cmd_pages_describe_bykey.go` + `cmd_pages_describe_parse.go` (describeComboBoxDatabaseMode), `validate_widgets.go` (comboBoxMode via the engine's selectMode; validateComboBoxDatabase = MDL-WIDGET16), `validate_widget_attribute_type.go` (comboBoxDatabaseRule = MDL-WIDGET39), `widget_describe.go` (definitionDefaults reads the unconditioned mode)
insight: **Diff against `mx update-widgets` on a copy, not against a hypothesis.** After the first fix the widget still failed; flattening mxcli's widget and the update-widgets output (keyed by PropertyKey, $ID dropped) gave exactly two differences, both properties the editorConfig hides in database mode — which pointed straight at the lifter rather than the writer. The lifter's gap was invisible to every test because no widget before the combo box hid anything in an else-if branch; dump the lifted rules for every installed .mpk before and after (only Combo box and TreeNode changed) to bound the blast radius. Mode-scoped reads keep biting: widgetValueMap (#1519), unmappedHiddenResets and the example generator's definitionDefaults each read every mode's mappings and each was wrong once a second conditioned mode existed — grep `def.Modes` when adding a mode. A new mode needs its check rules measured too: database mode makes `Attribute:` a String/Integer/Long/Enum target (MDL-WIDGET39 had assumed enumeration) and makes the value attribute required when a target is set (CE0642 'Value') — one throwaway page per row on mxbuild settled both. Describe must spell the mode by the datasource's KEY: the generic `DataSource:` selects the association mode. Measured on 11.12.5 and 11.15.0, Combo box 2.5.0 (the reporter's 2.6.2 was not available here).
